risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial operating metrics and quantified year-over-year results, but includes extensive standard forward-looking-statement disclaimers and broad risk qualifiers. Key risks include weak freight demand, excess industry capacity, pricing pressure, driver and third-party capacity shortages, fuel volatility, insurance claims, regulatory costs, and substantial equipment spending. Overall tone is operationally neutral, with modestly positive reported revenue growth offset by acknowledged market and cost pressures.
